android.name: Android
android.label: Podium Air Audit 2
android.summary: The current Android audit build includes the BitChord v1.8.1 integration and approved branding corrections. Device verification is still pending.
notes: Installs separately from regular Podium Air as com.podium.air.audit2.
Already using Audit 2? Install over it without uninstalling. The initial Audit app is separate.
Music files in shared storage may be shared between apps. Avoid deleting your main downloads while testing.
Automatic update polling is disabled in this audit build.
focus: Original, Liquid Glass and Chrome launcher icon spacing and edges.
One larger Chrome logo on Home, enlarged Library branding and the larger profile photo.
Playback, lyrics, queues, offline cache, Spotify import and stability.
knownIssues: Final device appearance and playback behaviour need tester confirmation.
This build is labelled 1.0.2-audit2-v1.8.1-branding4; it is not a published v1.0.3 release.

tv.name: Android TV / Google TV
tv.label: Podium Air TV Audit 1
tv.summary: The first Podium Air TV audit brings remote navigation, a TV player and lyrics to Android TV and Google TV. Download the universal test APK below; real-TV sign-in and playback still need tester confirmation.
notes: Android TV / Google TV running Android 8 or later. This APK does not support Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku or Apple TV.
Installs separately as com.podium.air.tv.audit. Keep your regular Podium Air app.
This is an optimized release build signed for testing. Automatic update polling is disabled.
Phone pairing is experimental and transfers a session over local HTTP. Use a trusted Wi-Fi network only.
focus: D-pad focus, select and back buttons across Home, Search, Library and Settings.
Playback, D-pad pause/seek, queue controls, lyrics and sleep/wake recovery.
TV speakers, Bluetooth or receiver output; compare spatial audio on/off. Try USB audio if supported.
knownIssues: No real-TV playback or sign-in success is claimed yet. Please include your TV model, Android version and remote type in reports.
Display refresh switching and spatial audio depend on the TV and connected audio hardware.

launch.title: Open & sign in
launch.text: Launch twice using your remote. Test sign-in and whether your session survives reopening.

playback.title: Control the music
playback.text: Use the remote to play, pause, skip and seek. Check TV speakers and your connected audio output.

library.title: Find your music
library.text: Type a search, open an album or playlist and revisit your library using only the remote.

offline.title: Check local playback
offline.text: If supported, try a test download or USB audio file. Check permission prompts and disconnected-network behavior.

visuals.title: Follow the focus
visuals.text: Check D-pad focus, back navigation, lyrics readability, logos and screen-edge clipping at your normal viewing distance.

stability.title: Sleep & return
stability.text: Switch TV apps, sleep and wake the TV, then resume. Report crashes, missing audio and lost remote focus.
